greetings.castor: Welcome, bard. I am Castor. I listen for pitch: every note, true or wandering.
greetings.pollux: And I am Pollux. I keep the pulse. Sit with us at the Canon, and we will sharpen you for the Choir.

greetings.castor: Back again? Good. The Choir grows louder every night, and so shall you.
greetings.pollux: My brother means that kindly. Tune up, bard. Let's find your beat.

greetings.castor: The Canon is tuned and the stars are out. A fine night to practise.
greetings.pollux: A fine night to win, too. Show us what the climb has taught you.

greetings.castor: Ah, our favourite bard. Your ear has grown since we last met.
greetings.pollux: Your timing, though? Let's see if it kept up. Hands ready.

note: One voice, two princes: Castor is steadier, slower and pitched a little down (rate); Pollux looser, quicker and pitched a little up. rate is applied at playback.
